name: Events Calendar
description: Manage events from the admin (title, dates, location, link, color) and show them anywhere with the EventsCalendar Verso block — as an upcoming-events list or a monthly calendar grid. WordPress parity: The Events Calendar.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: List events for the admin table and the public list/calendar block (own prefixed table only).
Create, update and delete events in the plugin's own prefixed table.
Register the events API endpoints under /api/v1/plugin/events-calendar/*.
Add the Eventos entry to the admin sidebar.
